blocks.html: This documentation provides a reference to the `validateCartGiftCardStep`. It belongs to the `@medusajs/medusa/core-flows` package.

This step validates that gift cards can be added to a cart. It throws an error
if a gift card is already applied to the cart or if the gift card currency does
not match the cart's currency.

children.description: Input to validate that gift cards can be added to a cart.
